prompt: Write a short retirement speech about a coworker named Andrea that's retiring after 24 years of service as a staff member working at Rutgers University.
response: Andrea, after 24 years of dedicated service at Rutgers University, it's time to hang up your hat. You've been a loyal staff member, and while you may not have always been in the spotlight, your hard work has not gone unnoticed. As you embark on this new chapter, remember that the university will always be here if you need a place to return to. Congratulations on your retirement, and we wish you all the best in your future endeavors.
